event: The player stands in the cobbled square, a healing draught in hand.
He works the cork free with his thumb; it comes out with a soft pop.
He drinks the red draught down in two swallows, sweet and faintly metallic.
Warmth spreads through his chest, but he has no wound for it to close.
He lowers the empty bottle and turns slowly to take in the square.
Cobbles run out in every direction from a stone well at the square's middle.
A wooden bench sits beside the well, empty.
By the well, a stone stair leads down into the dark below the square.
On the north side, steps climb to the doors of a long hall.
On the east side, a green door is set into a shopfront.
The square is quiet, and he stands by the well, free to go any way.
